style: Monochrome black, white and grey ink illustration with heavy black shadows and rain streaks, like a noir comic, where the only colour is glowing red: red lights, red laser lines and red target glows. No text, letters, logos, number plates or interface anywhere.

images.prompt: Wide low-angle shot of a rain-soaked elevated highway at night with a dark city skyline behind. Racing toward the viewer is a sleek white wedge-shaped 1980s sports car with black tinted windows, pop-up headlights and a glowing red scanner light bar across its nose, spray flying from its wheels. Behind it, two black vans give chase with their headlights on, and red laser lines from rooftop searchlights cut through the rain overhead. Wet asphalt reflecting the red glow.

Dynamic chase scene from an aerial three-quarter view: a transforming vehicle in mid-change from motorcycle to car leads the frame through an urban corridor while enemy vehicles with glowing red targeting reticles give chase, a helicopter above, motion blur on the background.

Three-quarter view of a rooftop helipad at night in the rain, city lights far below. In the middle, a sleek white wedge-shaped 1980s sports car with black tinted windows, pop-up headlights and a glowing red scanner light bar across its nose, its roof split open where the cockpit has just left. Shooting out of it to the right is a sleek white futuristic motorcycle with the same glowing red light bar on its nose, ridden by a pilot in a black helmet. Above them hovers a sleek white attack helicopter with a red light bar on its nose and stubby weapon pods. Red glows on the wet concrete.

Portrait poster composition: a masked vigilante pilot in a tactical suit with a reflective visor stands confidently in the foreground, a sleek white transformable vehicle behind, a corrupt city skyline and red scanner beams through smoke, heroic low angle, dramatic rim lighting.

High aerial view over a rain-soaked fictional city at night: tall skyscrapers, freeways full of streaming red tail lights, a bridge over a dark river, a harbor with cargo ships and cranes, a tunnel mouth in a hillside. A long black semi truck with a trailer drives along the freeway in the foreground, and a sleek white helicopter with a red light bar on its nose flies low over the river. A few rooftops glow red. No map, no borders, no lettering.
